checks.requirement: report should be saved as shell_report.txt in the /app directory

checks.check: Current shell identified as bash ("bash" or "/bin/bash") not a script path
checks.requirement: The current shell being used (identified by $0 or similar methods)
checks.note: Accepts $0 output "bash" or $SHELL output "/bin/bash"; rejects script paths like /replay.sh

checks.check: All shells from /etc/shells listed in report (including duplicate /usr/bin/zsh)
checks.requirement: A list of all installed shells found on the system (from /etc/shells)
checks.note: Reads /etc/shells at verification time; requires all 14 entries present

checks.requirement: A list of all installed shells found on the system (from /etc/shells)
checks.note: Explicitly rejects /usr/bin/tmux; flags any /bin/* or /usr/bin/* path not in /etc/shells

checks.check: Each shell verified as existing and executable
checks.requirement: Verification that these shells actually exist as executable files
checks.note: Accepts per-shell verification or general "all verified" statement

checks.check: Absolute path to each shell executable present
checks.requirement: The absolute path to each shell executable
checks.note: Covered by shell list check since /etc/shells contains absolute paths
